title: September Raku at Waterbrook
bring: Glazed bisqueware (3-4 pieces, 8 inches diameter max)
cost_text: Waterbrook & CCCG members $25; Non-Members $30 (cash or check only, paid to Kilnmaster)
summary: Fire 3-4 glazed bisque pieces (max 8 inches diameter) in a raku firing at Waterbrook Potters Studio on September 26, 2026. Raku glazes, horsehair and feathers provided. Members pay $25, non-members $30.
evidence_sentence: Waterbrook hosts a raku firing on September 26th where participants bring glazed bisqueware (3-4 pieces) and the studio provides raku glazes and post-fire reduction materials.
evidence_quote: Join us at Waterbrook Potters Studio for our next raku firing on September 26th . Cooler temperatures, crisp fall air, and a whole lot of fire, smoke, and glowing pots make this the perfect time to get outside and fire some work.
source_quote: Join us at Waterbrook Potters Studio for our next raku firing on September 26th
